requirements.quote:
For finite field groups, a conventional Diffie-Hellman [DH76]
   computation is performed.
requirements.condition: when the negotiated group is a finite field group
requirements.why_checkable: The finite-field shared-secret computation path and its operands can be inspected and tested.

requirements.quote:
The negotiated key (Z) is converted to a
   byte string by encoding in big-endian form and left-padded with zeros
   up to the size of the prime.
requirements.condition: when converting a finite-field Diffie-Hellman negotiated key Z to bytes
requirements.why_checkable: Known Diffie-Hellman values can verify byte order independently of padding.

requirements.quote:
The negotiated key (Z) is converted to a
   byte string by encoding in big-endian form and left-padded with zeros
   up to the size of the prime.
requirements.condition: when the big-endian encoding of finite-field Diffie-Hellman key Z is shorter than the prime size
requirements.required_behavior: left-pad the encoding with zero octets to the size of the prime
requirements.forbidden_behavior: strip or omit leading zero octets needed to reach the prime size
requirements.why_checkable: Boundary values can verify that the encoded secret has exactly the prime's byte length.

requirements.quote:
This byte string is used as the shared
   secret in the key schedule as specified above.
requirements.condition: after encoding and padding the finite-field Diffie-Hellman key Z
requirements.required_behavior: use the resulting byte string as the key schedule shared secret
requirements.forbidden_behavior: substitute an unencoded or differently padded value as the key schedule shared secret
requirements.why_checkable: The bytes passed into the key schedule can be compared with the required encoded and padded value.
